subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 10: revision; 'll' (ball, call, hill); segmenting and blending

show.line: Two l's at the end. Ball, hill, call! Let's read ll words.

hints: Two l's say one sound at the end.
Listen to the end of the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with ball.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bell does not rhyme with ball. Call rhymes with ball.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Ball, call. Same at the end!

parent_line: Can read words that end in ll, like ball, hill and doll.
